trails.label: Trails
trails.description: USFS and USGS mapped trails; closures and unmapped paths are not resolved.

roads.label: Roads
roads.description: Mapped roads include roads unsuitable for your Mazda. A line does not establish legal motor access.

campgrounds.label: Developed campgrounds
campgrounds.description: Two mapped developed sites in the surrounding buffer. Dispersed camps are not inventoried. Status is a retrieval snapshot.

trailheads.label: Trailheads / vehicle screen
trailheads.description: East Portal is your confirmed origin. High-clearance approaches are explicitly excluded from the vehicle screen.

gmu_boundaries.label: GMU boundaries
gmu_boundaries.description: Context only; a GMU does not establish license or access validity.

ownership.label: Mapped land ownership
ownership.description: PAD-US fee ownership inventory; not a cadastral survey or access authorization.

contours.label: 40 ft contour lines
contours.description: Exact 40-foot elevation intervals derived from USGS 3DEP; heavy lines every 200 feet.

water.label: Mapped water
water.description: Solid perennial, dashed intermittent/ephemeral, gray unknown or artificial. Historical NHD classes are not a 2027 flow forecast.
water.source: USGS NHD High Resolution; maintenance retired in 2023

canopy.label: Canopy cover · 2025
canopy.description: Actual modeled tree canopy percentage, 0–100%, at approximately 30 m. Does not measure understory cover.

darkness.label: Darkness · distance from access
darkness.description: Meters from nearest mapped trail, road or developed campground; 2000+ saturated

darkness_score.label: Darkness component
darkness_score.description: Meters from nearest mapped trail, road or developed campground; 2000+ saturated

official_topo.label: USGS topo · 40 ft · 2022
official_topo.description: Six official 2022 quadrangles with 40-foot contours. Original map trails and water remain printed here even when separate overlays are off.

sources.name: USFS wilderness boundary, trails, roads and recreation
sources.vintage: Inventory retrieved October 2026; individual road vintages vary
sources.note: Road geometry is not a legal-access or vehicle-condition determination.

sources.name: Official USGS US Topo quadrangles
sources.note: All six explicitly use 40-foot contour intervals. Local georeferenced mosaic; no remote tiles.

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program
sources.note: Elevation sampled at 10 m; supports hillshade, derived contours and slope proxies.

sources.name: USFS NLCD percent tree canopy
sources.note: Continuous 0–100% canopy estimates at about 30 m. Zero is valid; missing pixels are not treated as zero.

sources.name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset
sources.vintage: Legacy NHD High Resolution; retired October 2023
sources.note: Perennial is a historical classification, not measured water availability in 2027.

sources.name: USGS PAD-US fee ownership
sources.note: Candidate filter uses mapped USFS fee land within the wilderness; inventory boundaries do not grant access.

sources.name: CPW game management units
sources.note: 2027 season, hunt code and closure rules require the applicable regulations.

sources.name: Your CalTopo and observations
sources.note: Three supplied coordinates retained exactly; 2027 elk occupancy accepted as the planning assumption.
